name: Lisbon
tagline: The secret pastel de nata recipe from 1837, and 26 kitchens under the roof of an 1892 market.

Pastéis de Belém.description: The original pastel de nata factory, with a secret recipe since 1837.

Time Out Market Lisboa.description: The 1892 produce market turned food hall, with 26 chefs and restaurants under one roof.

Belcanto.description: Chef José Avillez's flagship table in Chiado, Lisbon's most awarded restaurant. Two Michelin stars.

Cervejaria Ramiro.description: Lisbon's benchmark seafood house since the 1950s, with shrimp, barnacles, and cold beer, just like always.

A Ginjinha Sem Rival.description: A historic ginjinha (sour cherry liqueur) bar with more than a century of history, next to Praça dos Restauradores.
